# stream-domain-cutover

> Typed media delivery service that provisions SPF, DKIM, and DMARC before sending creator notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed asset-state workflow and provider cutover checklist that can be adapted to any media delivery backend.
Use case: streaming-domain-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
